requirements.normative_requirement: VM ownership and orphan recovery use systemd unit identity, cgroup, lease nonce, VM UUID, and process start identity rather than numeric PID alone.
requirements.primary_verification: PID reuse simulation and stale state directory corpus.

requirements.normative_requirement: pidfds are used for call-process lifecycle where available and mandatory under the 0.1 host profile.
requirements.primary_verification: Rapid PID reuse and signal/wait stress.

requirements.normative_requirement: Release 0.1 never adopts a surviving VM after daemon restart; it stops and quarantines unverifiable state.
requirements.primary_verification: Crash daemon with live VM at every lease state.

requirements.normative_requirement: Client disconnect, daemon death, guest-agent death, and system shutdown have explicit drain/stop/quarantine behavior.
requirements.primary_verification: Kill each component and reboot/shutdown simulation.
